reading: Dessau Phosphor is the main camp's widest-split design: the style lens put it first of round 13 (8.2) and it drew 4 promise votes. Interaction (5.3) and usability (5.5) sank it, and it finished 6.47, #12 of 17. The judges love three things and want them kept: (1) the poster head on every page, a lowercase Outfit page name beside a square of section ink over a bar, which gives the strongest title-first sight line; (2) one round phosphor tube per page holding that page's one live figure, which the tour has since proved as a graft (L044 in Live Figures, style's first in its heat); (3) the four-shapes-four-jobs rule (circle is light, square is the family's, bar is the page's, triangle needs a look), with its legend in the footer. Home's scanlined glowing key word with the big blooming radar was "the most alive greeting of the round" (soul, feedback). Five things sank it, each named by several lenses. The ~110px cream headline is the brightest mass on the page and pushes the box and setup below the fold (system, type, interaction, usability, skeptic, style). Below the fold the page is matte print in off-motif inks: navy cards at hue 259 (style, skeptic), ochre, terracotta and pink (feedback), and thick filled bars and squares (soul). To do and Status fall back to stock cards, with ISO dates, no late, and a tube that repeats the open count (all eight lenses, one way or another). 31 small targets and icon-only nav places sit beside sentence-case 'Vera' (interaction, usability, type, system). The radar collides with a rectangular Next up monitor (skeptic, soul). To win, it has to stay a poster at a glance but become a working system under the poster. That means one-line rows marked by its own shapes, graphite instead of navy, low-chroma inks in thin bars, and the light carried down from the greeting into the data: a NOW lamp and line, ringed day numerals on the radar keyed to the rows. All of this should sit at a headline scale that lets the box live in the first screen. The tour's lessons say which grafts will take: ones that draw data the page already holds and replace something (the NOW line across To do, numerals that join a figure to its list, a clickable readout strip). Lit rails end to end, amber outlines and inverted-green chips read as pasted on or as alarms.

briefs.name: Dessau, Wired Through
briefs.hypothesis: The style lens already ranked this line first, and its losses came from fixable things: headline scale, navy cards, off-motif inks, To do and Status as stock cards, small targets and an unlabelled nav. Those faults cost interaction and usability about three points. This cross keeps every element the judges named as the line's soul: the poster head, the round tube with one live figure, the four shapes with their legend, the scanlined lit word and the big radar. Under the poster it adds a working body built from the tour's proven grafts. Lit Manual's NOW line runs across To do. Waypoint Lamps' clickable readout strip becomes the poster's base bar. Waypoint's ringed day numerals join the radar to the Coming up rows. Each graft is redrawn in the line's own shapes (bar, circle, square, triangle), so it reads native and not pasted. That lifts interaction and usability toward 7.5 without losing the 8+ identity, which should put it level with or above Desk Terminal, Joined and the tour finals.
briefs.brief:
Start from r13-wild-3's files (cross/x14a-a/palettes/r13-wild-3.json, variants/r13-wild-3/sheet.css, templates/, static/icons.svg). Keep Outfit for display, the body face as now, VT323 only on glass.

PALETTE (graphite, not navy; inks low-chroma):
- surface #15171a
- surface-2 #1a1c1f
- surface-3 #202326
- field #0f1113
- line #2a2d30
- line-2 #3a3d41
- edge #737a80
- bubble #181a1d
- bubble-them #221f1b
- bezel #222426
- ink #e2ddd2
- heading #e6e0d4 (bone, no longer brighter than ink)
- ink-2 #c3bdb1
- dim #a39e95
- faint #8f8b84
- label #aea795
- Section inks, all at about 25-35 chroma and reading as material, not neon: plans #86b4ba (sea-glass), todo #9fb0c2 (steel; it was ochre, which clashed with late), ideas #a597b4 (dusty lilac, replacing saturated mauve), people #bf9d80 (clay), shows #b4a0a8 (ash rose, replacing pink), seasons #b08a7c, outing #8fc29b, wishes take shows.
- accent #9fb8d6
- wash #86b4ba
- Late is amber #e8b04a and appears only as words, a row's left edge, or the small triangle. Never as an outline or a slab.
- danger #ef6661
- brand #6dff9c, lit #85e7a2, unchanged.
- glow 0.95, screenGlow 1.1, topGlow 0.8.

TYPE SYSTEM (five steps, written into sheet.css as --step-* custom properties):
- poster-1 (Home question only): Outfit 600, clamp(2.75rem, 5.6vw, 4.5rem), so 72px at 1280. line-height .92, tracking -0.035em, colour heading. Two lines, max-width 11ch.
- poster-2 (each section page's name): Outfit 600, clamp(2.25rem, 4.4vw, 3.5rem) (56px), tracking -0.03em, lowercase.
- head (section heads such as Coming up and To do): Outfit 600, 1.5rem, sentence case.
- body: 1rem/1.5.
- label: 0.8125rem, 600, tracking .06em, small caps.
- Figures: tabular lining everywhere. Day numerals in Outfit 300 at 2.5rem, line-height .8.
- Lowercase lives ONLY in poster-1 and poster-2. The bar nav, buttons and heads are sentence case: Vera, Ideas, Plans, To do, Wishes, Memory, Family, Status, Settings, each with its word beside its icon (the four right-hand places get their words back).
- Help, intro and lede text get max-width 62ch.

HOME (templates/home.html, .welcome):
- Left column: the speaker line (Vera's glass face, then the date as a label). Under it the question at poster-1, 'tell Vera, / she'll *plan*.', with 'plan.' in #6dff9c and the full stop inside the lit span. Keep L106's E1 two-layer halo and the 1-in-3 scanlines running through the lit letters. The rest of the line is bone at full ink, never dimmed.
- The box (.ask-frame) sits directly under the question and must end above y=560 at 1280x900. The starters sit under it as stacked, full-width keys, each min-height 44px, with a small square glyph (the family's shape) before each.
- Right column: ONE round tube, the radar (.radar inside .crt.next-up), at 22rem. The rectangular Next up monitor is removed as a separate box. Its words go inside the round glass: under the hub, in VT323, 'NEXT UP' (an inverse-free label in lit), 'Oaks Park roller rink', 'Sun 13:00 · in 2 days', and the '3 more on the radar' link.
- Blips become waypoint rings: each plan is a 1.5px ring of about 1.6rem carrying its day numeral (4, 9, 17, 24) in VT323. Only the next plan's ring is lit #6dff9c with the halo; the others are lit at 55% with no halo.
- The rings sit on the 1w/2w/4w range rings as now. The sweep and afterglow stay.
- The same numerals lead the Coming up rows below, so figure and list share one mark with no legend.
- POSTER BASE BAR (replaces the thick slate rule at the foot of .welcome): a 2px bar (the page's shape) with a readout strip under it. Its cells read: Today Fri 2 Oct · Plans 4 · To do 4 · Late 3 · Ideas 12. Each cell is a link at least 44px tall to its page (Late goes to /tasks?show=open#late).
- Cell layout: a label, a dotted leader, then the figure in Outfit 300 1.75rem, tabular.
- The Late figure and word are amber, with a 0.6rem triangle before the label. 'Today' is plain bone, not an inverted chip.
- On the phone the strip is a 2x3 grid of the same links.
- SETUP: one line, not a card. A 3px amber left edge, a small amber triangle, 'Finish setting up · 3 steps', then the next step as a link ('Choose your own password'), then 'then Telegram, then Google Calendar' and 'All the setup steps →'. The whole row is 44px or more.
- Kids' wishes: one line under To do: 'The kids' wishes  Maya 0 open · Theo 0 open  All →'.
- DASHBOARD: three columns kept. The section-ink caps over each column head (L023) thin from 0.375rem to 3px, and the ink is the new low-chroma ink.
- Coming up: one-line rows. A day numeral in Outfit 300 2.5rem with the month and weekday stacked beside it as labels, then the title (a link), then 'in 2 days' at right in dim.
- On the first row, a NOW lamp: a 0.5rem #6dff9c circle with a 6px halo, sitting on a 1px lit hairline that runs from the left edge to the next row only. Light covers the stretch from now to next, not end to end.
- To do on Home: the same row grammar as the To do page (below), top 4.
- Lately added: one-line rows. The kind is an OUTLINED 1.1rem square (1.5px in the kind ink) holding the kind icon in that ink, then the title, then 'Activity' as a label in the kind ink, then 'for Maya, Theo' at right. The filled print squares are replaced. 'Something to eat · 2 restaurants to try →' is the last row.

TO DO (templates/tasks.html):
- Poster head: a steel square tile, 'things to do', the lede at 62ch.
- The round tube shows 'LATE / 3 / OF 4 OPEN' and stops repeating the open count. When nothing is late it shows 'NEXT DUE / 4 / DAYS'.
- Base bar strip: Open 4 · Late 3 · Done this week N · Add something to do. The primary green button '+ Add something to do' sits in the poster head at right under the tube (one green primary per page). The fold opens below.
- Filters become a segmented row: Open, Done, Cancelled, All, each a 44px key with the current one under a 3px steel bar. Then a search field and a 'Search' key. The filter box is removed.
- LIST, grafted from Lit Manual and Departures Platformed: one line per task. From left: a date column in label type ('Sun 27 Sep', worded, and a clock time only when one was set, never 19:56), then a 1.5px vertical rule with a small circle node per row.
- Next comes the tick: a 1.25rem empty square (1.5px line-2) with a 44px hit area (L198) that previews its tick on hover and focus. Then the title in 600, the person with the person icon in dim, a dotted leader, then 'was due 5 days ago' in amber words at right, then an 'Edit' key (44px).
- Late rows have a 3px amber left edge and an amber triangle node on the rule. The tick box itself is never amber.
- Between the last late row and the rest, the NOW LINE: a #6dff9c circle lamp with the label 'Now' on the date column, and a 1px lit line with 6px bloom running across the full list width, fading to nothing at the right edge. Light sits on this line only.
- Rows with no date sit under it with 'No date'.
- The column head reads 'Tick when done'.
- Snooze and reminder edits open in a disclosure under the row, unchanged in function. A row with a reminder shows a small hollow circle lamp beside the person.

PLANS (plans.html, plans_month.html):
- The tube shows 'NEXT IN / 2 / DAYS'. The empty band beside the name is filled with a lede: 'Next: Oaks Park roller rink, Sunday 13:00' (a link).
- Base bar strip: This month 6 · Next 4 Oct · List / Month (tabs as 44px keys).
- Month: the day numerals are Outfit 300 1.5rem, tabular. Today is the lit circle as now. Each day with a plan carries a small hollow circle ring around its numeral in the plans ink, echoing the radar's rings.
- The week rows lose fills: cells are surface with 1px line hairlines. The event chips keep the 3px plans-ink left edge, with titles held to one line with an ellipsis.

STATUS (status.html):
- Poster head as now, with the spend tube (its long words raised to 1rem VT323, not 14px).
- Base bar strip: Working 6 · Off 7 · Spent today $0.00.
- The three cards become open columns separated by 1px line rules, with no boxes. The section numerals 01 02 03 04 are set in Outfit 300 2.5rem in a left margin of 3.5rem, hanging outside the text edge in accent steel, not inline.
- Lamps: a filled #6dff9c circle means working. A hollow circle in faint means off. An amber triangle means needs a look. The state is also given in words after the name ('working', 'off').

SETTINGS (settings.html): a poster head 'settings' with a graphite square tile. The tube shows 'TO SET UP / 3'. The section cards become one-line rows: an outlined ink square, the name, a dotted leader, its state in words, and a →. Each row is 44px or more.

IDEAS and FORM: the poster head with the lilac tile. Idea cards become one-line rows in the Lately added grammar. The form's fields are graphite with a 1px line-2 border and a 2px #6dff9c focus ring with a 4px halo. Labels are in the label step. Selects keep the chevron.

CHAT: the poster head 'Vera'. Vera's lines are on glass, a bubble with the 1-in-3 raster and a lit left edge 1px. The family's lines are on bubble-them, matte, square-cornered (the family's square).

FOOTER: the four-shape legend (circle Light, square Yours, bar The page, triangle A look) is kept, in sentence case at the label step, each glyph 0.75rem in its real colour.

TARGETS: every link, key, tick and nav place is at least 44x44 on Home and To do. The target is 0 small targets on Home.
briefs.borrows:
Its own judges' fixes, most-cited first:
(1) Headline too large and the brightest mass. Cut Home to about 72px, set it at 600 in bone, and put the box above the fold (type, interaction, skeptic, system, style, usability).
(2) To do as one-line rows with worded dates, amber late, a square tick and an amber triangle, with the round screen showing the late count (style, system, interaction, usability, soul).
(3) Navy cards to neutral graphite (style, skeptic), and ochre, terracotta and pink to steel, slate and low-chroma inks (feedback).
(4) 31 small targets to 44px (system, interaction, usability).
(5) Words back in the nav, which is set in sentence case, with lowercase kept to the posters only (interaction, type, system).
(6) One round screen on Home instead of the radar overlapping the monitor (skeptic, soul).
(7) Thin the ink bars to caps, outline the kind squares, and carry one lit element (a NOW lamp) into Coming up (soul).
(8) Status numerals as a left margin, and a lede to fill Plans' empty band (style).
(9) A measure of 60-65ch (type).

From the other camp:
(A) Lit Manual, Relit Rails' NOW line across the To do list (t3-figure-refine; the judges' 'best single moment in the heat'). Files: cross/x14a-a/variants/t3-figure-refine/templates/tasks.html and home.html, and sheet.css (the due-queue axis and NOW-line rules). Shots: cross/x14a-a/out/t3-figure-refine/shots/todo.png and home.png. It is rebuilt in Dessau's shapes: a circle lamp, a bar for the line, triangles for late nodes.
(B) Waypoint Lamps' readout strip (t3-console-graft; 'the best glance summary of the round'; system asked for it as a global element). Files: cross/x14a-b/variants/t3-console-graft/templates/home.html and sheet.css. Shot: cross/x14a-b/out/t3-console-graft/shots/home.png. It becomes the poster's base bar on every section page, with the cells made into 44px links (its judges' fix) and the inverted-green 'Fri 2 Oct' chip dropped (the tour lesson on inverted chips).
(C) Waypoint Lamps' waypoint rings carrying the day numerals that lead the rows (the tour's candidate principle 2: one mark joins a figure to its list). Files: cross/x14a-b/variants/t3-console-graft/templates/home.html and plans_month.html. They are redrawn as rings on Dessau's own radar, and as rings round the plan days on the month.
(D) Departures, Platformed's one-line timetable To do with dotted leaders and late words at the right margin, and its stacked starter keys (t3-timetable-refine). Files: cross/x14a-a/variants/t3-timetable-refine/templates/tasks.html and sheet.css. Shot: cross/x14a-a/out/t3-timetable-refine/shots/todo.png.

From the ledger: L198 (Signal Galley, r8-idea-1), a 44px hit area round a small tick box with no layout change, for the tick on To do and Home.
briefs.avoids:
It answers every recurring criticism:
- The shouting cream headline: now 72px at 600 in bone, with only 'plan.' lit.
- The box and setup below the fold: the box ends above 560px, and setup is one line.
- Navy hue 259: replaced by graphite.
- Off-motif ochre, terracotta and pink: replaced by low-chroma steel, sea-glass, lilac and ash rose, in 3px caps and outlined squares.
- To do and Status as stock cards: now rows and open columns in the line's own shapes.
- ISO dates and invented 19:56 times: worded dates, with a clock time only when set.
- The tube repeating the open count: it shows the late count.
- Icon-only places and the lowercase nav beside 'Vera': words and sentence case.
- 31 small targets: 0.
- Radar colliding with the monitor: one round screen.
- Light ending at the greeting: the NOW lamp on Coming up, the NOW line on To do, lit next ring.

It also avoids the tour's failures:
- No rail lit end to end: light covers only now to next.
- No amber outlines or slabs, and no amber tick boxes: amber is words, an edge and small triangles.
- No inverted-green chips.
- No starters scrolled sideways.
- No figure restating the list in a new code: the rings carry the same numerals as the rows, and the strip's figures are links that are each said once.

What it gives up to make room:
- The rectangular Next up monitor.
- The filled print kind squares the style lens liked (now outlined).
- The ochre To do ink.
- The thick 0.375rem column bars.
- The all-lowercase voice outside the posters.
- About 40px of headline.
briefs.title: 'tell Vera, / she'll *plan*.' with 'plan.' lit #6dff9c, the full stop in the lit run, set as two poster lines in lowercase Outfit 600 (Vera keeps her capital). It is untried in the tour and the crossing rounds. It keeps what eight notes favoured in 'Tell Vera what to plan.': an imperative that names who hears you, ends on the job word where the glow lands, and cannot be answered 'no' or read as 'show me the plan'. It adds the promise of the work (she plans: weekends, ideas kept, reminders), which is FamilyDB's job in two words. It breaks into two balanced poster lines of 10 and 11 characters at 72px, and fits a phone at 44px. The lit word is five letters, so the halo stays short of glare.
